content.text:
The release workflow is now pushed to `chore/release-2.3.0`. This run used the new token permission from 96fe882, so GitHub accepted the workflow file. Two commits went up:

- **34db084** adds `.github/workflows/release.yml`, the same file as in my earlier comment.
- **20254ef** turns the plain-text mentions of `release.yml` in `CONTRIBUTING.md` back into links.

Before pushing I ran `npm run lint` (which includes actionlint) and the docs link test, and both passed. An earlier run had also passed the full `npm run check` with the same two changes. I skipped the git hooks and couldn't run commitlint here because the package was missing. CI's `commitlint` job will check both commit messages on this PR, and they follow the same format as the earlier commits that passed.

All three selected items (1, 3 and 5) are now in this PR. The PR description has the `## Release notes` section the workflow reads.

**After you squash-merge:**
```bash
git switch main && git pull
git tag -a v2.3.0 -m v2.3.0
git push origin v2.3.0
```
This is the workflow's first run. If it passes, it creates a draft release and moves `v2`. Review the draft under Releases and publish it. If it fails, you can still tag and move `v2` by hand as before.
